revision: plan v1.1 — critic findings #1-#10 incorporated by orchestrator (see .autoforge/reviews/plan.md)
objective: Build an in-browser speed-reading trainer (no build, vanilla ES modules, static site) that presents books/texts as 1-3 word RSVP chunks with ORP alignment, baseline calibration, retention quizzes, and local IndexedDB progress tracking; no backend, no telemetry, no DRM handling. Scope authority: tracker-index.md has zero entries; objective fallback is the sole scope authority.
invariants: src/lib/* never imports src/ui/*, never touches document/window at import time, never calls fetch
store.js is the only IndexedDB user
player.js is the only module owning a timer; app.js (not the engine) owns the document visibilitychange listener that calls player.pause()
orp.js is the only module with ORP constants
zip.js is the only ZIP parser
pipeline.js reaches EPUB via dynamic import; a missing epub.js becomes UnsupportedFormatError('EPUB support unavailable'), never ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND
DOM contract pinned in plan.md section 1b; ORP anchor contract = grid 1fr auto 1fr; views may add classes only, never ids; only shell edits index.html
package.json is exactly {"type":"module"} (no deps/scripts) and is owned by shell

modules.objective: Static presentation foundation: HTML shell implementing pinned DOM contract, CSS tokens (contrast >=4.5:1, focus-visible, --font-scale/--text-align vars, .rsvp-stage grid anchor), a11y primitives, and minimal package.json.
modules.acceptance: Serve with `python3 -m http.server 8080`; DOM contract ids present (#app, #view-library, #view-player, #view-quiz, #view-dashboard, #live-region, .rsvp-stage/.rsvp-left/.rsvp-orp/.rsvp-right styles), no console errors; a11y.announce() writes to #live-region; prefersReducedMotion() reflects OS toggle; keyboard tab reaches all shell controls; package.json content exactly {"type":"module"}.

modules.objective: tokenize() + chunk() per ADR-8 policy (1-3 words, default 2, no paragraph merge, sentence-final split, >14-char word alone).
modules.acceptance: `node --test test/text.test.js` green: paragraph boundary never merged; sentence-final punctuation ends chunk; word >14 chars own chunk; size 1/2/3; default 2; trail preserved.

modules.objective: ORP rule as single source of truth: orpIndex() table 1:0, 2-5:1, 6-9:2, 10-13:3, 14+:4 clamped; orpParts().
modules.acceptance: `node --test test/orp.test.js` green for lengths 1,2,5,6,9,10,13,14,20 including clamp; left+orp+right concatenation equals input.

modules.objective: Seeded heuristic cloze generation (deterministic per seed, distractors from same text) and normalization-tolerant scoring.
modules.acceptance: `node --test test/quiz.test.js` green: same seed gives identical quiz; different seed differs; n=5; accepted[] includes the blanked token; normalizeAnswer handles case/punctuation/whitespace; scoreQuiz returns correct/total/pct/perQuestion; total=0 yields pct 0 (not NaN).

modules.objective: Pure metrics: wpm, comprehensionPct, summarize trend, suggestNextWpm between-session rules (>=80 +10%, <60 -10%, else hold).
modules.acceptance: `node --test test/metrics.test.js` green: wpm(300,60000)=300; elapsedMs=0 guarded; comprehensionPct boundaries; trend up/flat/down; suggestNextWpm rules; all functions pure (no mutation of input).

modules.objective: Thin async IndexedDB wrapper: DB speedread v1, stores texts/quizzes/sessions/settings (keyPath id), export/import with schemaVersion validation.
modules.acceptance: Browser console on served app: openStore() then put/get/getAll/del round-trip on each store; exportAll() returns {schemaVersion:1,texts,quizzes,sessions,settings}; importAll rejects wrong schemaVersion with a documented error object and otherwise replaces data (user confirm dialog is app/ui-library's job, not store's); put rejects on quota error with readable message (no silent drop). Grep: no other file references indexedDB.

modules.objective: Minimal ZIP central-directory reader (method 0/8, DecompressionStream deflate-raw) + EPUB container/OPF/spine/XHTML text extraction; explicit UnsupportedFormatError otherwise. Module may span 2 child sessions (zip then epub) against frozen readZip signature.
modules.acceptance: `node --test test/zip.test.js test/epub.test.js` green with in-file node:zlib fixture: method 0 and 8 both inflate; chapter titles in spine order; markup stripped; zip64/encrypted/other-method/non-UTF-8 throw UnsupportedFormatError with readable reason; never silent empty/garbled output. Real-book gate deferred to verify-acceptance step 2.

modules.objective: README (run command, Node >=22.7 note, privacy/no-network statement, corrected glossary, evidence notes, non-goals, DRM/rights notice, 4-week pilot plan) and a public-domain calibration sample text.
modules.acceptance: README documents `python3 -m http.server 8080` + Node >=22.7 for tests, zero network/telemetry/accounts posture, ORP = Optimal Recognition Point, evidence notes, non-goals, user-rights/DRM notice, and 4-week pilot plan (baseline, 3 sessions/week with retention quiz, week-4 re-baseline; comprehension trend matters more than WPM); assets/sample.txt public domain, UTF-8, 300-500 words.

modules.objective: DOM-free timing engine: rAF + wall-clock deadline, chunk/end/state events, injectable now/schedule (defaults performance.now/requestAnimationFrame), seek/step/setWpm; exposes pause() as the visibility hook (app owns the listener).
modules.acceptance: `node --test test/player.test.js` green with fake clock: nextDelay(chunk,wpm)=chunk.words.length*60000/wpm (1-word and 2-word cases); one chunk event per deadline with no accumulated drift; end fires once; pause stops emissions; seek/step clamp; setWpm applies from next chunk only; getState accurate; pause() asserted to stop the scheduler and not resume until play() [orchestrator fix: WPM accuracy for multi-word chunks].

modules.objective: TXT normalize (BOM, CRLF, blank runs), chapterize heuristics with single-chapter fallback, ingest() dispatch with dynamic EPUB import and friendly error when epub.js is absent.
modules.acceptance: `node --test test/pipeline.test.js` green: normalization cases; CHAPTER N / section-mark detection and one-chapter fallback; .txt dispatch returns {title, source:'txt', chapters}; unknown extension throws UnsupportedFormatError; module imports cleanly with epub.js absent and .epub ingest rejects with UnsupportedFormatError('EPUB support unavailable'), not ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND (critic fix #7).

modules.objective: Import/list/open/delete/export-import view; copyright + DRM-unsupported notice; callbacks only (no store access); owns its harness page.
modules.acceptance: Open test/harness/library.html on the served app with stub callbacks: file input calls onImportFile(file); render(texts) shows title/source/word count; open/delete callbacks receive correct id; export/import buttons call callbacks; rights notice visible; full keyboard operation; focus returns to list after delete.

modules.objective: RSVP renderer with ORP-aligned fixed anchor (grid 1fr auto 1fr), keyboard map (Space/arrows/+/-/Esc), sentence-boundary announcements, SR/reduced-motion manual-advance mode, and settings controls (fontScale, textAlign, orpEnabled, chunkSize incl. experimental 3, reducedMotion override) reporting via onSettingsChange.
modules.acceptance: Open test/harness/player-view.html with stub player: ORP character at fixed x at --font-scale 1 and 1.5; Space/arrow/plus-minus/Esc per key map; visual region aria-hidden, role=status announces at sentence boundaries only; prefers-reduced-motion defaults to manual sentence mode via aria-live polite; settings controls call onSettingsChange and renderSettings reflects persisted values; consumes injected player instance, creates no timer.

modules.objective: Editable cloze quiz view (split from former ui-quiz-dashboard per critic fix #8).
modules.acceptance: Open test/harness/quiz-view.html: 5 cloze items with auto-generated/edit-before-use label; submit calls onSave with edited questions; cancel calls onCancel; empty state renders clean.

modules.objective: Progress dashboard: WPM with comprehension, trend, experimental label for 3-word sessions, explicit-accept WPM suggestion (split per critic fix #8).
modules.acceptance: Open test/harness/dashboard.html: table shows WPM and comprehension from same session, trend badge, suggestion button requiring explicit accept calling onAcceptWpm(n); experimental label on 3-word sessions; empty state renders clean.

modules.objective: Composition root: owns store + player instances, visibilitychange listener calling player.pause(), routes the four views, wires import/play/quiz/dashboard flows, settings persistence, and session records.
modules.acceptance: `node --test test/` all green AND browser seams check: import assets/sample.txt, baseline session recorded with kind:'baseline', open player, exit, reload page and text/settings/sessions persist; exactly one #view-* visible at a time; tab-switch mid-playback pauses via visibilitychange and never fast-forwards; JSON import calls store.importAll only after user confirm. Full walkthrough is verify-acceptance's job.

modules.objective: Independent acceptance gate: real-EPUB quality gate (ADR-3, cut permitted here), full browser walkthrough, a11y pass (gate 4), privacy pass (ADR-10), docs pass.
modules.acceptance: walkthrough.md records observed results for: (1) node-level ingest dispatch on fixture EPUB -> source:'epub' with correct chapter count (skip+record ADR-3 fallback if cut); (2) real DRM-free Gutenberg EPUB imports through UI with correct chapter count and readable text (cut permitted here if it fails); (3) sample TXT -> baseline -> RSVP 1-2 words -> quiz -> dashboard -> reload persistence; (4) keyboard-only loop, screen-reader mode, reduced-motion default, contrast spot-check; (5) Network panel zero requests after load and no fetch( in src/; (6) README matches shipped behavior (incl. Node >=22.7 + pilot plan) and overclaim check passes.
